title: MongoDB Quick Reference
description: Find a word or command you have seen in a lesson. Each short note tells you what it does. Open the linked lesson for the full example.

entries.name: Document
entries.summary: One record that keeps named values together.

entries.name: Collection
entries.summary: A named group of documents in a database.

entries.name: _id
entries.summary: The unique label for a document in its collection.

entries.name: mongosh
entries.summary: The shell used to type MongoDB commands.

entries.name: Array
entries.summary: Keep a list inside a document field.

entries.name: insertOne
entries.summary: Add one new document to a collection.

entries.name: findOne
entries.summary: Read one matching document, or null if none match.

entries.name: find
entries.summary: Read matching documents through a cursor.

entries.name: $gt
entries.summary: Match a value greater than the given value.

entries.name: $in
entries.summary: Match any value in a supplied list.

entries.name: updateOne
entries.summary: Change the first document matching a filter.

entries.name: $set
entries.summary: Set a named field to a new value.

entries.name: $inc
entries.summary: Add a number to an existing numeric field.

entries.name: deleteOne
entries.summary: Remove the first document matching a filter.

entries.name: Validation rule
entries.summary: Check a document shape before accepting a write.

entries.name: aggregate
entries.summary: Run a list of data-processing steps.

entries.name: $match
entries.summary: Keep documents that pass a filter in a pipeline.

entries.name: $group
entries.summary: Put matching values into groups for a result.

entries.name: $sum
entries.summary: Add values together inside a group.

entries.name: $lookup
entries.summary: Join matching documents from another collection.

entries.name: createIndex
entries.summary: Build a guide that can speed up matching searches.

entries.name: explain
entries.summary: See how MongoDB plans to read the data.

entries.name: Transaction
entries.summary: Make several changes work as one all-or-nothing job.
entries.syntax: await session.withTransaction(async () => { /* writes with this session */ });

entries.name: MongoClient
entries.summary: Connect a Node.js program to MongoDB.

entries.name: read role
entries.summary: Allow a tool to read a database without changing it.
